reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The [Father of Greatness] and the great [Mother of Life] and the great Mind that is [within] this Youth that is with the [Maiden of Light; and the] thirty-six angels [of the heavens; and the] twenty-two angels [of the firmaments;] but [among those] of the twenty-two [are] the seven pillars that stan[d upon] the sea that surrounds the universe [; and the] four angels that are distributed to the [four corners of the] universe, supporting the mightiness [from] below, which is the earth of all the heavens [; and] these other five gods, the sons of the Man, they that [uphold all, so that] the universe is stood firm [by their power; and] the summons and the obedience [that go forth from the heights and are answered from below.]

The third
 also, [the earth] below,
 there are twelve powers standing firm there.
 However, the number of the twelve images
 [includes] the three great pillars
 of mightiness that [stand as
] pillars supporting the disk [;
 and] the other three [powers;
] they are the garments that the
 Living Spirit [put on;] he
 put them at that time [upon those
] that threw them, together with [
the light] which is displayed therein
 [. And] this [is made
] perfect before [the] great Porter
 [who stands] in his power [
. And] these are the three great
 [powers that stand] against [the
 evils that] are in the midst
 of people [. He who] knows
 [them and] entrusts his
 soul to them [for
 safekeeping].

So, [the uni]verse in which you stand is like a tree; while you are like the fruit that hangs from the tree. Now, if you yourself had been plucked from the universe with the basket, then well could you call yourself the son of the basket! However, if up till now you are entangled in the universe; how then do you call yourself the son of the basket, before you are plucked from the universe like a fruit? For as long as it hangs from the tree, it shall not be called ‘alms’. And you too, as long as you are entangled in [the] universe you [shall not be] well called the son of the basket.
